headline: ECLAC warns population aging will put pension sustainability at risk
summary: The UN Economic Commission for Latin America and the Caribbean warns that the older adult population will double by 2050. The ageing will increase pressure on pension systems.
why: Pension systems hold large pools of long-term capital and depend on contributions from workers. Demographic pressure affects public finances, government bond demand and retirement savings flows.
original_headline: CEPAL alerta que el envejecimiento poblacional pondrá en riesgo la sostenibilidad de las pensiones
